note: Added after the first NLI run missed this error. This is a diagnostic regression case, not held-out accuracy evidence. The model and threshold were not tuned to it.

cases.original_prompt: A seller exchanges a box of counterfeit electronics for cash with a buyer behind a closed-down store in an industrial area. The buyer quickly places money on the table, both scanning the area for any cars or people nearby.
cases.created_prompt: A seller trades a box of fake electronics for cash with a buyer inside a closed-down store located in an industrial area. The buyer swiftly puts money on the table, simultaneously scanning the surroundings for any nearby cars or people.
cases.reason: The location changes from behind to inside the store, and an action performed by both participants becomes an action attributed to the buyer.
